reuse.why: The change reuses tag parsing, spreadsheet access, budget writes and averaging helpers, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses the new shared category selector and setZero bypasses the shared action runner.

duplication.why: Category eligibility is repeated in SQL and imperative checks, the filtered budget-writing loop remains duplicated in setZero, and average sign conversion repeats setNMonthAvg.

placement.why: Budget selection and calculation remain in the budget actions module, with method registration and undo wrapping in the existing application layer.

scope.why: The edits focus on the requested month-wide actions, their shared implementation, method registration and associated tests.

maintainability.why: The shared selector and runner improve several actions, but maintaining parallel eligibility and execution paths still requires coordinated changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth reimplements getMonthActionCategories eligibility, while setZero repeats execution handled by setBudgetsForActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth expresses hidden-category and saved-template exclusions as imperative checks that duplicate getMonthActionCategories SQL predicates.

abstraction_drift.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: includeHiddenCategories adds one shared selection parameter and conditional SQL branch; copyPreviousMonth bypasses shared selection, and setZero bypasses the shared execution helper.
